title: Simultaneous étale approximation of relative completed local maps over a locally Noetherian G-ring base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: Both the base map and the relative map must be approximated while preserving their compatibility to a prescribed adic order. The proof combines local-map approximation with Popescu smoothing and finite-presentation descent to transport an étale model through a smooth intermediate algebra before specializing it back to an elementary étale neighbourhood.
